name: infinity-whatsapp-monorepo
description: Root convenience layer for the Infinity WhatsApp monorepo. Each package has its own package.json; running npm install at the repo root delegates to them.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix whatsapp-client install && npm --prefix whatsapp-client run build && npm --prefix endpoints-integrator install && npm --prefix media install && npm --prefix paperclip-bridge install
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:endpoints && npm run build:media && npm run build:bridge
